title: Sources Sought: T-38 Side Brace Trunnion Assembly (PN: 202607928)
description: 1.0 Description / Background The Government is conducting market research to identify interested and capable sources for the manufacturing of the T-38 Side Brace Trunnion Assembly, Part Number (PN) 202607928. The T-38 side brace trunnion is a critical subcomponent of the aircraft's main landing gear. It serves as a primary structural support during landing and other operational loads, enabling the main landing gear to fully extend and retract. This part is specific to the T-38 aircraft operational envelope. Please note: A formal Technical Data Package (TDP) is not yet available, as the drawings are in the final stages of approval. Specific quantities and delivery schedules have not yet been determined. 2.0 Required Capabilities To be considered a capable source for this requirement, respondents must demonstrate the ability to meet the following critical parameters: Manufacturing Equipment: Minimum 5-axis CNC machining capability. Material Sourcing & Machining: Capability to procure and machine Aluminum 7050-T7451. Precision Tolerances: Capability to machine contours and radii to tight tolerances, as small as 0.001 inch. Size Envelope: Capability to machine a part with an overall envelope of approximately 2 feet in length and 7 inches in diameter. CAD/CAM Utilization: Capability to utilize a SolidWorks .SLDPRT file to generate machining profiles. Special Processes: Capability to perform (or utilize an approved subcontractor for) the following post-machining processes: Shot peen Anodize Heat treat Fluorescent penetrant inspection Certifications: Contractors and any utilized subcontractors must comply with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements. 3.0 Submission Instructions Interested parties who believe they possess the expertise and capabilities to fulfill this requirement are invited to submit a Capability Statement. The Capability Statement should be brief (no more than 5 pages) and must include: Company Information: Company Name, CAGE Code, UEI number, Point of Contact, address, phone number, and business size/socioeconomic status under the applicable NAICS code. Technical Capability: A summary of your company's capabilities specifically addressing each of the manufacturing and special process requirements listed in Section 2.0. Past Performance: Information on any past government or commercial contracts for parts involving similar materials, complexities, and manufacturing processes. 4.0 Disclaimer This Sources Sought notice is issued for informational and market research purposes only. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. This notice does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Respondents are advised that the Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice; all costs associated with responding will be solely at the interested party�s expense.

description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1232SA26Q0854 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for providing advice and counsel to the Groundwater Transfer and Injection Project (GTIP) Phase 2 team at Agricultural Research Service (ARS) National Sedimentation Laboratory (NSL), collaborators, and stakeholders in selecting appropriate sites and creating a most probable cost estimate for the project. title: Portugal – Research and development consultancy services – Support to the European School Survey Project on Alcohol and Other Drugs (ESPAD)
description: The ESPAD project (European School Survey Project on Alcohol and Other Drugs) is an international project that collects data every four years in over 35 European countries on the use of alcohol, tobacco, medicines, illicit drugs, and other addictive behaviours, and possible correlates with such behaviours, among 15–16-year-old school students through probabilistic school surveys. The project started in 1995, and the next data collection is planned for 2028. Since ESPAD is a unique source of internationally comparable and trend information about prevalence and patterns of addictive behaviours among school population in Europe that has been proven informative for researchers, policy-makers, and other stakeholders, and it increasingly provides evidence for evaluation of national and European drug policies, EUDA has a strong interest in maintaining high quality and comparability of the research process and study outputs. The EUDA is committed to giving support to the international coordination of the project and actively participating in its coordination. The main purpose of this contract is therefore to collect, compile, analyse and report on the results on substance use among secondary school students across Europe with the objective to strengthen EUDA’s monitoring capacities on drugs use and to anticipate and alert on emerging drug-related risks among European adolescents.

title: Water Tanker/Pump Repair
description: Request for Quote (RFQ): Water Tanker/Pump Repair FA930126Q0030 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA930126Q00301 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for Fire Truck Water Tanker/Pumper Repair. This acquisition is set aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. Background: The 412 Logistics Readiness Squadron Vehicle Management Flight needs contracted vendor services to replace the agent water tank assembly and associated components on Fire Department Water Tender with registration number 11L00144, which was delivered to Vehicle Management with multiple leaks on top of the tank and a noticeable sag in the center when fully loaded, causing the tank to rub the body and damage the exterior integrity of the tank. Upon inspection, it was found that the damage was a result of the structural integrity of the agent tank that had diminished over the years. It is beyond the capabilities of the vehicle management flight technicians to repair. See attached SOW for further information and included photos of the vehicle for reference. Product service code (PSC) J042 and North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 811310 are being considered for this requirement. Basis for Award: Comparative Evaluation The Government intends to award a contract to the responsible offeror whose quotation, conforming to the solicitation, is determined to represent the best value to the Government. Evaluation Methodology In accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will utilize a Comparative Evaluation process. Rather than rating or scoring each quotation individually against a rigid, predetermined evaluation rubric, the Government will compare all received quotations directly against one another to identify which submission offers the most advantageous solution. Evaluation Factors for Comparison The Government will compare quotations based on the following factors to determine which provides the best overall value: Evaluation Factors: *Technical Capability - the Government will compare the proposed features, methods, and technical solutions of each quotation directly against the others. The goal is to determine which proposed approach provides the greatest benefit, utility, and likelihood of successfully meeting or exceeding the requirements outlined in the Statement of Work (SOW). *Past Performance - the Government will compare the recent and relevant past performance records of the competing offerors. The Government may utilize the Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting System (CPARS) and other independent government or commercial sources to determine which offeror presents the lowest performance risk and the highest probability of success. *Price -the Government will compare the proposed prices to ensure they are fair and reasonable. Price will be evaluated in conjunction with the non-price factors to determine if the relative benefits of a specific quotation justify its proposed cost. *Delivery and warranty Selection Decision: Because this is a comparative evaluation, the Government is not required to establish a predefined rating scale. The Government reserves the right to select a quotation that is not the lowest priced if the direct comparison reveals that the technical superiority or stronger past performance of a higher-priced quotation provides a better overall value to the Government. The final decision will be based on a documented rationale explaining why the successful quotation is the best value for the Government. The tasks to be carried out include: Complete Replacement: Safely remove the structurally degraded agent water tank assembly and all associated failing components. Structural Integrity: Install a new water tank assembly capable of fully supporting the maximum loaded water capacity without sagging, bowing, or rubbing against the vehicle's exterior body. System Integration: Ensure all plumbing, valves, and water delivery components are correctly integrated with the new tank and are completely leak-free under operational pressure. Exterior Restoration: Complete all necessary specialized painting, coating, and bodywork required to restore the exterior integrity of the vehicle, matching the required Fire Department specifications. Description of requirements: The vendor must have proven hands-on experience servicing KME fire apparatus� and possess the necessary tooling and diagnostic capabilities specific to KME systems. Formal KME service center certification is not mandatory; however, the vendor must guarantee that all maintenance and repairs meet or surpass KME manufacturer specifications. Estimated period of performance: 240 Days ARO. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA930126Q00301 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for Fire Truck Water Tanker/Pumper Repair. This acquisition is set aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. Background: The 412 Logistics Readiness Squadron Vehicle Management Flight needs contracted vendor services to replace the agent water tank assembly and associated components on Fire Department Water Tender with registration number 11L00144, which was delivered to Vehicle Management with multiple leaks on top of the tank and a noticeable sag in the center when fully loaded, causing the tank to rub the body and damage the exterior integrity of the tank. Upon inspection, it was found that the damage was a result of the structural integrity of the agent tank that had diminished over the years. It is beyond the capabilities of the vehicle management flight technicians to repair. See attached SOW for further information and included photos of the vehicle for reference. Product service code (PSC) J042 and North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 811310 are being considered for this requirement. Basis for Award: Comparative Evaluation The Government intends to award a contract to the responsible offeror whose quotation, conforming to the solicitation, is determined to represent the best value to the Government. Evaluation Methodology In accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will utilize a Comparative Evaluation process. Rather than rating or scoring each quotation individually against a rigid, predetermined evaluation rubric, the Government will compare all received quotations directly against one another to identify which submission offers the most advantageous solution. Evaluation Factors for Comparison The Government will compare quotations based on the following factors to determine which provides the best overall value: Evaluation Factors: *Technical Capability - the Government will compare the proposed features, methods, and technical solutions of each quotation directly against the others. The goal is to determine which proposed approach provides the greatest benefit, utility, and likelihood of successfully meeting or exceeding the requirements outlined in the Statement of Work (SOW). *Past Performance - the Government will compare the recent and relevant past performance records of the competing offerors. The Government may utilize the Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting System (CPARS) and other independent government or commercial sources to determine which offeror presents the lowest performance risk and the highest probability of success. *Price -the Government will compare the proposed prices to ensure they are fair and reasonable. Price will be evaluated in conjunction with the non-price factors to determine if the relative benefits of a specific quotation justify its proposed cost. *Delivery and warranty Selection Decision: Because this is a comparative evaluation, the Government is not required to establish a predefined rating scale. The Government reserves the right to select a quotation that is not the lowest priced if the direct comparison reveals that the technical superiority or stronger past performance of a higher-priced quotation provides a better overall value to the Government. The final decision will be based on a documented rationale explaining why the successful quotation is the best value for the Government. The tasks to be carried out include: Complete Replacement: Safely remove the structurally degraded agent water tank assembly and all associated failing components. Structural Integrity: Install a new water tank assembly capable of fully supporting the maximum loaded water capacity without sagging, bowing, or rubbing against the vehicle's exterior body. System Integration: Ensure all plumbing, valves, and water delivery components are correctly integrated with the new tank and are completely leak-free under operational pressure. Exterior Restoration: Complete all necessary specialized painting, coating, and bodywork required to restore the exterior integrity of the vehicle, matching the required Fire Department specifications. Description of requirements: The vendor must have proven hands-on experience servicing KME fire apparatus� and possess the necessary tooling and diagnostic capabilities specific to KME systems. Formal KME service center certification is not mandatory; however, the vendor must guarantee that all maintenance and repairs meet or surpass KME manufacturer specifications. title: Water Tanker/Pump Repair
description: Request for Quote (RFQ): Water Tanker/Pump Repair FA930126Q0030 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA930126Q00301 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for Fire Truck Water Tanker/Pumper Repair. This acquisition is set aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. Background: The 412 Logistics Readiness Squadron Vehicle Management Flight needs contracted vendor services to replace the agent water tank assembly and associated components on Fire Department Water Tender with registration number 11L00144, which was delivered to Vehicle Management with multiple leaks on top of the tank and a noticeable sag in the center when fully loaded, causing the tank to rub the body and damage the exterior integrity of the tank. Upon inspection, it was found that the damage was a result of the structural integrity of the agent tank that had diminished over the years. It is beyond the capabilities of the vehicle management flight technicians to repair. See attached SOW for further information and included photos of the vehicle for reference. Product service code (PSC) J042 and North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 811310 are being considered for this requirement. Basis for Award: Comparative Evaluation The Government intends to award a contract to the responsible offeror whose quotation, conforming to the solicitation, is determined to represent the best value to the Government. Evaluation Methodology In accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will utilize a Comparative Evaluation process. Rather than rating or scoring each quotation individually against a rigid, predetermined evaluation rubric, the Government will compare all received quotations directly against one another to identify which submission offers the most advantageous solution. Evaluation Factors for Comparison The Government will compare quotations based on the following factors to determine which provides the best overall value: Evaluation Factors: *Technical Capability - the Government will compare the proposed features, methods, and technical solutions of each quotation directly against the others. The goal is to determine which proposed approach provides the greatest benefit, utility, and likelihood of successfully meeting or exceeding the requirements outlined in the Statement of Work (SOW). *Past Performance - the Government will compare the recent and relevant past performance records of the competing offerors. The Government may utilize the Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting System (CPARS) and other independent government or commercial sources to determine which offeror presents the lowest performance risk and the highest probability of success. *Price -the Government will compare the proposed prices to ensure they are fair and reasonable. Price will be evaluated in conjunction with the non-price factors to determine if the relative benefits of a specific quotation justify its proposed cost. *Delivery and warranty Selection Decision: Because this is a comparative evaluation, the Government is not required to establish a predefined rating scale. The Government reserves the right to select a quotation that is not the lowest priced if the direct comparison reveals that the technical superiority or stronger past performance of a higher-priced quotation provides a better overall value to the Government. The final decision will be based on a documented rationale explaining why the successful quotation is the best value for the Government. The tasks to be carried out include: Complete Replacement: Safely remove the structurally degraded agent water tank assembly and all associated failing components. Structural Integrity: Install a new water tank assembly capable of fully supporting the maximum loaded water capacity without sagging, bowing, or rubbing against the vehicle's exterior body. System Integration: Ensure all plumbing, valves, and water delivery components are correctly integrated with the new tank and are completely leak-free under operational pressure. Exterior Restoration: Complete all necessary specialized painting, coating, and bodywork required to restore the exterior integrity of the vehicle, matching the required Fire Department specifications. Description of requirements: The vendor must have proven hands-on experience servicing KME fire apparatus� and possess the necessary tooling and diagnostic capabilities specific to KME systems. Formal KME service center certification is not mandatory; however, the vendor must guarantee that all maintenance and repairs meet or surpass KME manufacturer specifications. Estimated period of performance: 240 Days ARO. title: Netherlands – Health services – Arbodienstverlening GGD Brabant-Zuidoost
description: Met deze aanbesteding wil de aanbestedende dienst de veiligheid, de gezondheid en het welzijn van de medewerkers bevorderen, zodat deze vitaal en duurzaam inzetbaar zijn en blijven én inzetten op verzuim-beheersing en -preventie. Binnen de GGD BZO werken mensen met grote betrokkenheid aan de gezondheid van onze inwoners. Tegelijkertijd zien we de druk in ons werk en op (de gezondheid van) onze medewerkers toenemen. Gezondheid en inzetbaarheid zijn geen vanzelfsprekendheid, maar vragen om bewuste aandacht en gerichte keuzes. De druk op gezondheid en inzetbaarheid neemt toe o.a. door: Tekorten arbeidsmarkt Oplopende pensioenleeftijd –langer doorwerken Groei van mantelzorgtaken onder medewerkers Toename werkdruk en stress –mentale gezondheid Zware fysieke en mentale belasting Deze ontwikkelingen vragen om een gerichte en samenhangende aanpak, waarin de GGD kiest voor gezondheid als vertrekpunt, wat vastgelegd wordt in een organisatiebreed gezondheidsbeleid. Dit beleid moet een strategisch kader bieden voor gezondheid en inzetbaarheid van medewerkers, gericht op duurzame gedragsverandering (geen losse initiatieven). Het beleid moet aansluiten op de missie, visie, doelstellingen én behoeften van medewerkers. Het zal gaan over een combinatie van generieke én doelgroepgerichte aanpak die aansluit bij de leeftijdsfase, aard van de werkzaamheden en/of persoonlijke situatie van medewerkers. Naast de uitvoering van de wettelijk vastgelegde Arbodienstverleningstaken ondersteunt de arbodienstverlener leidinggevende én werknemer bij (preventief) verzuim. Verwachtingen worden uitgesproken en waar van toepassing vastgelegd. De arbodienstverlener initieert activiteiten op het gebied van verzuimpreventie, gebaseerd op eigen kennis en signalering van knelpunten. Ook informatie die vanuit de GGD gedeeld wordt, neemt de opdrachtnemer mee in activiteiten m.b.t. verzuimpreventie. Te denken valt aan het initiëren van een training over omgaan met psychische belasting , het faciliteren van een informatiespreekuur voor vrouwen die te maken hebben met overgangsklachten of over het goed inrichten van mantelzorg naast het werk. Partner in preventie en gezondheidsbeleid wat de GGD heeft vastgesteld. Een verzuimmelding vindt plaats op basis van vertrouwen. Medewerker en leidinggevende hebben hierover het gesprek. Op basis van het gesprek worden vervolgafspraken gemaakt; toets ondersteuningsbehoefte en consultatie bedrijfsarts. Ieder traject is anders en verdient maatwerkafspraken.

title: Finland – Business services: law, marketing, consulting, recruitment, printing and security – Perintäpalvelut Lohjan kaupungille
description: Hankinnan kohteena on perintäpalvelut Lohjan kaupungille (jäljempänä "Hankintayksikkö" tai "Tilaaja"). Hankittavat palvelut (jäljempänä "Palvelut") sisältävät: - Tilaajan erääntyneiden saatavien maksukehotukset - julkis- ja yksityisoikeudellisten saatavien vapaaehtoisen perinnän - teknisenä välittäjänä toimimisen ulosottokelpoisten saatavien osalta - yksityisoikeudellisten riidattomien saatavien oikeudellisen perinnän - jälkiperinnän ja niihin mahdollisesti liittyvien riita- ja rikosasioiden hoidon - luottotappiosuositusten antamisen - saldoilmoitukset - konkurssivalvonnat yli 1000 euron saatavista - maksuhäiriömerkinnän automaattisen poiston - raportoinnin - tilitykset - perintää koskevat lakimiespalvelut - sähköisen asiointipalvelun Tilaajalle ja velallisille - asiakaspalvelun ja tukipalvelun puhelimitse, sähköpostitse ja online-palvelun kautta - Tilaajalle nimetyn palveluntuottajan asiakkuudesta vastaavan asiakkuuspäällikön sekä asiakaspalveluhenkilön - toiminnan näkökulmasta tarpeelliset tietojärjestelmien ja ohjelmistojen rajapinnat ja integraatiot eri tietojärjestelmiin. Hankinnan kohde kattaa vain Lohjan kaupungin tarvitsemat Palvelut, asiakkaana ei ole muut kaupunkikonserniin kuuluvat yhtiöt ja yhteisöt. Hankittavat Palvelut koskevat yli 1000 euron saatavia. Tätä pienempien saatavien perinnän kaupunki hoitaa itse. Palvelut koskevat julkisoikeudellisia ja yksityisoikeudellisia saatavia. Asiakasryhminä on sekä yksityishenkilöt (ml. kuluttajat) että yhteisöt. Hankinta koskee palvelun käyttöönoton jälkeen erääntyviä saatavia. Aiempia saatavia ei siirretä edelliseltä palveluntuottajalta uudelle. Vapaaehtoinen perintä koskee Suomessa sijaitsevien velallisten lisäksi ulkomailla sijaitsevia velallisia. Muilta osin ulkomaan perinnästä sovitaan tapauskohtaisesti erikseen. Tilaaja ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana, vaan Palveluita hankintaan Tilaajan tarpeen mukaan. Tilaaja päättää, mitkä saatavat se antaa palveluntuottajan perittäväksi. Tilaajalla on myös oikeus päättää yksittäisen saatavan perinnän toteuttamisesta omana työnään. Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta. Sopimus on irtisanottavissa tilaajan toimesta noudattaen kuuden (6) kuukauden irtisanomisaikaa ja palveluntuottajan puolesta noudattaen yhdeksän (9) kuukauden irtisanomisaikaa. Palveluntuotannon suunniteltu aloitus on loppuvuonna 2026. Tarkempi aloitusajankohta vahvistetaan Hankintayksikön ja valittavan palveluntuottajan kesken ennen sopimuksen allekirjoittamista. Hankinnan perusteella valitaan yksi (1) palveluntuottaja tuottamaan Palvelut. Hankinnan kohdetta on kuvattu tarkemmin jäljempänä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.
